privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At [Khaleea], we are committed to protecting your privacy and keeping your data confidential. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our app. By using the app, you agree to the terms described in this policy.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
body: We collect two types of information:
1.1 Personal information:
• Personal identification information that you provide when registering or using the app, such as your name and phone number.
• Account and profile information.
1.2 Non-personal information:
• Information collected automatically such as device data, operating system, IP address, and usage history.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Information
body: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
• Providing services and improving app performance.
• Personalizing your experience and providing customized content.
• Contacting you about updates, offers, or technical support.
• Analyzing usage data to improve our products and services.
• Complying with applicable legal obligations and regulations.

sections.title: 3. Sharing Information with Third Parties
body: We do not sell or rent your personal information to any third party. However, we may share your information with:
• External service providers who help operate the app, such as hosting providers.
• Government or legal authorities if required by law or to protect our rights or the rights of other users.

sections.title: 4. Information Security
body: We use appropriate security technologies, such as encryption, to protect your data from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure, or destruction. However, no security system can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

sections.title: 5. Cookies
body: The app uses cookies to collect and analyze data about how you use the app. You can modify your browser settings to refuse cookies, but this may affect certain app functions.

sections.title: 6. User Rights
body: • You can access, modify, or delete the information we collect about you at any time through your account settings.
• You can request permanent deletion of your account and personal information from our databases, provided that we are not legally required to retain it for a longer period.

sections.title: 7. Children’s Privacy
body: We do not direct our services to children under the age of 13 and do not knowingly collect personal information from them. If we discover that we have collected information from a child without parental consent, we will delete it immediately.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this Privacy Policy
body: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy from time to time. You will be notified of any major changes through the app or by email.

sections.title: 9. Contact Us
body: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your personal information, you can contact us by email: [support@khaleeaapp.com]
